rationale: The Garage Cam (CAM-I2) is offline with a dark LED and no heartbeat, and the customer confirmed it still fails to come online even when placed directly next to the base station after a reset attempt. This rules out weak signal (RSSI -83 dBm was only at the garage location) and points to a hardware fault. Per escalation policy criterion (5), a device failing next to the base station after a reset warrants escalation to FAE (L2).

results.text: Escalate when any of the following holds: (1) two or more peripherals fail at the same time while the base station is online; (2) a firmware or protocol mismatch remains after an OTA attempt or OTA is not possible; (3) the standard frontline fix was executed and the problem persists; (4) the app's device list and the base station binding table disagree; (5) a device fails even next to the base station after a factory reset.

Hold SYNC for 15 seconds until the LED flashes white. This removes the peripheral's own binding but does not remove it from the base station table; remove it in the app first, then reset, then pair again.
